faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: The answers to the questions on your mind are here.

delivery.question: How many days does it take for a corporate site to be ready?
delivery.answer: Depending on the scope of the project, it is usually completed within 3-6 weeks.

pricing.question: How are prices determined?
pricing.answer: A custom quote is prepared for you based on the number of pages, features, and integration needs.

revisions.question: How many revision rights do I have?
revisions.answer: Necessary revisions are made together during the design phase, and the site proceeds with your approval.

maintenance.question: Is there post-launch support?
maintenance.answer: Yes. We offer technical support and maintenance services after launch.

migration.question: Can you migrate the existing site?
migration.answer: Yes. We can migrate to the new site while preserving your existing content and SEO values.

mobile.question: Will it be mobile-friendly?
mobile.answer: Yes. All sites are developed to be mobile-friendly and work seamlessly on all devices.
